package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchemaV1          = "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestSchemaV1      = "diagnostic-assessment-plan-request.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestSchemaV1 = "diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapResultSchemaV1  = "diagnostic-assessment-bootstrap-result.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1             = "diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1"
	DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1                      = "diagnostic-fixed-v1"
	DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1                  = "diagnostic-bootstrap-v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentReservationSchemaV1      = "student-diagnostic-assessment-reservation.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1           = "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1"
	DiagnosticPlacementConsumeSchemaV1           = "diagnostic-placement-consume.v1"
	DiagnosticPlacementSchemaV1                  = "diagnostic-placement.v1"
	DiagnosticPlacementRoutePolicyV1             = "diagnostic-placement-route-v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1             = "diagnostic-placement-band-v1"
)

var diagnosticDigest = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

// DiagnosticAssessment is intentionally metadata-only: Course never sends questions, answers or scorer data.
type DiagnosticAssessment struct {
	LessonID        string      `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID          string      `json:"task_id"`
	TaskVersion     int64       `json:"task_version"`
	UpdatedAt       time.Time   `json:"updated_at"`
	LessonOrder     int         `json:"lesson_order"`
	TaskOrder       int         `json:"task_order"`
	LearningTargets []TargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog struct {
	Schema      string                 `json:"schema"`
	CourseID    string                 `json:"course_id"`
	Revision    string                 `json:"curric\u0075lum_revision"`
	Assessments []DiagnosticAssessment `json:"assessments"`
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1 struct {
	Schema                   string    `json:"schema"`
	StudentID                string    `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID                 string    `json:"course_id"`
	ExpectedPreviousRevision *int      `json:"expected_previous_revision,omitempty"`
	OnboardingVersion        int64     `json:"-"`
	BootstrapPolicyVersion   string    `json:"-"`
	BootstrapContextDigest   string    `json:"-"`
	BindingRevision          int64     `json:"-"`
	BindingDigest            string    `json:"-"`
	BindingGoalCode          string    `json:"-"`
	BindingDirectionCode     string    `json:"-"`
	BindingCreatedAt         time.Time `json:"-"`
	RequestHash              string    `json:"-"`
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentPlan struct {
	Schema                 string                 `json:"schema"`
	ID                     string                 `json:"id"`
	StudentID              string                 `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID               string                 `json:"course_id"`
	PlanRevision           int                    `json:"plan_revision"`
	PolicyVersion          string                 `json:"policy_version"`
	CourseRevision         string                 `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PlanDigest             string                 `json:"plan_digest"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64                  `json:"onboarding_version"`
	BootstrapPolicyVersion string                 `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
	BootstrapContextDigest string                 `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
	Assessments            []DiagnosticAssessment `json:"assessments"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time              `json:"created_at"`
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord struct {
	IdempotencyKey, RequestHash string
	Plan                        DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
	BindingRevision             int64
	BindingDigest               string
	BindingGoalCode             string
	BindingDirectionCode        string
	BindingCreatedAt            time.Time
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentReservation is Planner's delivery proof. It deliberately
// contains only the Student-safe receipt and is not an attempt-state copy.
type DiagnosticAssessmentReservation struct {
	Schema       string `json:"schema"`
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	PlanID       string `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision int    `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest   string `json:"plan_digest"`
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord struct {
	StudentID, CourseID string
	AttemptID           string
	Reservation         DiagnosticAssessmentReservation
	ReservationDigest   string
	ReceivedAt          time.Time
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentResult is the aggregate-only Student authority consumed
// for a placement decision. It must never grow answers, items, or scorer data.
type DiagnosticAssessmentResult struct {
	Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
	StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
	CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
	AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
	Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
	Total                 int       `json:"total"`
	Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
	Band                  string    `json:"band"`
	BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
	PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
	ResultDigest          string    `json:"result_digest"`
	CompletedAt           time.Time `json:"completed_at"`
}

type DiagnosticPlacementConsumeRequest struct {
	Schema string `json:"schema"`
}

// DiagnosticPlacement is a fixed, future-planning input only. It is neither a
// Student path/mastery write nor a task/runtime instruction.
type DiagnosticPlacement struct {
	Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
	StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
	CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
	AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
	Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
	Total                 int       `json:"total"`
	Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
	Band                  string    `json:"band"`
	BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
	PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
	ResultDigest          string    `json:"result_digest"`
	ResultCompletedAt     time.Time `json:"result_completed_at"`
	RouteCode             string    `json:"route_code"`
	RoutePolicyVersion    string    `json:"route_policy_version"`
	DecidedAt             time.Time `json:"decided_at"`
	DecisionDigest        string    `json:"decision_digest"`
}

type DiagnosticPlacementRecord struct {
	RequestID, RequestHash string
	Decision               DiagnosticPlacement
}

// DiagnosticPlanDigestInput is the explicit, versioned canonical projection.
type DiagnosticPlanDigestInput struct {
	Schema                 string                 `json:"schema"`
	ID                     string                 `json:"id"`
	StudentID              string                 `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID               string                 `json:"course_id"`
	PlanRevision           int                    `json:"plan_revision"`
	PolicyVersion          string                 `json:"policy_version"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64                  `json:"onboarding_version"`
	BootstrapPolicyVersion string                 `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
	BootstrapContextDigest string                 `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
	CourseRevision         string                 `json:"course_content_revision"`
	Assessments            []DiagnosticAssessment `json:"assessments"`
}

func DiagnosticPlanDigest(plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (string, error) {
	b, e := json.Marshal(DiagnosticPlanDigestInput{plan.Schema, plan.ID, plan.StudentID, plan.CourseID, plan.PlanRevision, plan.PolicyVersion, plan.OnboardingVersion, plan.BootstrapPolicyVersion, plan.BootstrapContextDigest, plan.CourseRevision, plan.Assessments})
	if e != nil {
		return "", e
	}
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(s[:]), nil
}
func ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlan(plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan, id, student, course, revision, policy, contentRevision, digest string, createdAt time.Time) error {
	if plan.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1 || plan.ID != id || plan.StudentID != student || plan.CourseID != course || plan.PlanRevision < 1 || plan.PlanRevision != mustPositiveInt(revision) || plan.PolicyVersion != DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1 || plan.PolicyVersion != policy || plan.CourseRevision != contentRevision || plan.OnboardingVersion < 1 || plan.BootstrapPolicyVersion != DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(plan.BootstrapContextDigest) || !canonicalUTCMicro(plan.CreatedAt) || !plan.CreatedAt.Equal(createdAt) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(plan.CourseRevision) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(plan.PlanDigest) || plan.PlanDigest != digest || len(plan.Assessments) < 3 || len(plan.Assessments) > 5 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if !canonicalUUID(plan.ID) || !canonicalUUID(student) || !canonicalUUID(course) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, a := range plan.Assessments {
		if !canonicalUUID(a.LessonID) || !canonicalUUID(a.TaskID) || a.TaskVersion < 1 || a.LessonOrder < 0 || a.TaskOrder < 0 || !canonicalUTCMicro(a.UpdatedAt) || seen[a.TaskID] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[a.TaskID] = true
		if _, e := NormalizeTargetRefs(a.LearningTargets); e != nil {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	}
	actual, e := DiagnosticPlanDigest(plan)
	if e != nil || actual != plan.PlanDigest {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func ValidateDiagnosticPlan(plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	return ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlan(plan, plan.ID, plan.StudentID, plan.CourseID, strconv.Itoa(plan.PlanRevision), plan.PolicyVersion, plan.CourseRevision, plan.PlanDigest, plan.CreatedAt)
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticPlanRequest(input DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1) (DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1, error) {
	if input.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestSchemaV1 || !canonicalUUID(input.StudentID) || !canonicalUUID(input.CourseID) || input.OnboardingVersion < 1 || input.BootstrapPolicyVersion != DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(input.BootstrapContextDigest) || input.BindingRevision < 1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(input.BindingDigest) || input.BindingGoalCode == "" || input.BindingDirectionCode == "" || !canonicalUTCMicro(input.BindingCreatedAt) || (input.RequestHash != "" && !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(input.RequestHash)) || (input.ExpectedPreviousRevision != nil && *input.ExpectedPreviousRevision < 1) {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	binding, err := NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: input.BindingGoalCode, DirectionCode: input.BindingDirectionCode, CourseID: input.CourseID, BindingRevision: input.BindingRevision, PolicyVersion: input.BootstrapPolicyVersion, BindingDigest: input.BindingDigest, Active: true, CreatedAt: input.BindingCreatedAt})
	if err != nil || binding.GoalCode != input.BindingGoalCode || binding.DirectionCode != input.BindingDirectionCode {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}
func NormalizeDiagnosticCatalog(input DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog) (DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error) {
	if input.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogSchemaV1 || !canonicalUUID(input.CourseID) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(input.Revision) || len(input.Assessments) > 100 {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i := range input.Assessments {
		a := &input.Assessments[i]
		if !canonicalUUID(a.LessonID) || !canonicalUUID(a.TaskID) || a.TaskVersion < 1 || a.LessonOrder < 0 || a.TaskOrder < 0 || !canonicalUTCMicro(a.UpdatedAt) || len(a.LearningTargets) > 100 {
			return DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, ErrValidation
		}
		targets, err := NormalizeTargetRefs(a.LearningTargets)
		if err != nil {
			return DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, ErrValidation
		}
		a.LearningTargets = targets
		k := a.TaskID
		if seen[k] {
			return DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[k] = true
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticPlacementConsume(input DiagnosticPlacementConsumeRequest) error {
	if input.Schema != DiagnosticPlacementConsumeSchemaV1 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateDiagnosticReservation(receipt DiagnosticAssessmentReservation, plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	if receipt.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentReservationSchemaV1 || !canonicalUUID(receipt.ID) || receipt.ID != plan.ID || receipt.PlanID != plan.ID || receipt.PlanRevision != plan.PlanRevision || receipt.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(receipt.PlanDigest) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidateStoredDiagnosticReservation(record DiagnosticAssessmentReservationRecord, plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	if record.StudentID != plan.StudentID || record.CourseID != plan.CourseID || record.AttemptID != plan.ID || !canonicalUTCMicro(record.ReceivedAt) || ValidateDiagnosticReservation(record.Reservation, plan) != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	digest, err := DiagnosticReservationDigest(record.Reservation)
	if err != nil || digest != record.ReservationDigest {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func DiagnosticReservationDigest(receipt DiagnosticAssessmentReservation) (string, error) {
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(receipt)
}

func ValidateDiagnosticResult(result DiagnosticAssessmentResult, plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) error {
	if result.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1 || result.StudentID != plan.StudentID || result.CourseID != plan.CourseID || result.CourseContentRevision != plan.CourseRevision || result.PolicyVersion != plan.PolicyVersion || result.AttemptID != plan.ID || result.PlanID != plan.ID || result.PlanRevision != plan.PlanRevision || result.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || !canonicalUUID(result.StudentID) || !canonicalUUID(result.CourseID) || !canonicalUUID(result.AttemptID) || !canonicalUUID(result.PlanID) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(result.CourseContentRevision) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(result.PlanDigest) || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(result.ResultDigest) || result.Total < 3 || result.Total > 5 || result.Correct < 0 || result.Correct > result.Total || result.Percent != result.Correct*100/result.Total || !canonicalUTCMicro(result.CompletedAt) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	band, err := diagnosticPlacementBand(result.Correct, result.Total)
	if err != nil || result.Band != band || result.BandPolicyVersion != DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	actual, err := DiagnosticResultDigest(result)
	if err != nil || actual != result.ResultDigest {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

// DiagnosticResultDigest mirrors Student's documented aggregate-only
// projection. ResultDigest itself is deliberately excluded from its preimage.
func DiagnosticResultDigest(result DiagnosticAssessmentResult) (string, error) {
	projection := struct {
		Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
		StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
		CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
		PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
		AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
		PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
		PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
		Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
		Total                 int       `json:"total"`
		Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
		Band                  string    `json:"band"`
		BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
		PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
		CompletedAt           time.Time `json:"completed_at"`
	}{result.Schema, result.StudentID, result.CourseID, result.CourseContentRevision, result.PolicyVersion, result.AttemptID, result.PlanID, result.PlanRevision, result.Correct, result.Total, result.Percent, result.Band, result.BandPolicyVersion, result.PlanDigest, result.CompletedAt.UTC()}
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(projection)
}

func DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision DiagnosticPlacement) (string, error) {
	copy := decision
	copy.DecisionDigest = ""
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(copy)
}

func ValidateStoredDiagnosticPlacement(decision DiagnosticPlacement, plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan, requestID, requestHash, digest string) error {
	expectedHash, hashErr := DiagnosticPlacementConsumeHash(plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
	if hashErr != nil || !canonicalUUID(requestID) || requestID != plan.ID || requestHash != expectedHash || decision.Schema != DiagnosticPlacementSchemaV1 || decision.StudentID != plan.StudentID || decision.CourseID != plan.CourseID || decision.CourseContentRevision != plan.CourseRevision || decision.PolicyVersion != plan.PolicyVersion || decision.AttemptID != plan.ID || decision.PlanID != plan.ID || decision.PlanRevision != plan.PlanRevision || decision.PlanDigest != plan.PlanDigest || decision.DecisionDigest != digest || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(digest) || !canonicalUTCMicro(decision.ResultCompletedAt) || !canonicalUTCMicro(decision.DecidedAt) || decision.RoutePolicyVersion != DiagnosticPlacementRoutePolicyV1 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	want, ok := placementRoute(decision.Band)
	if !ok || decision.RouteCode != want || decision.Total < 3 || decision.Total > 5 || decision.Correct < 0 || decision.Correct > decision.Total || decision.Percent != decision.Correct*100/decision.Total || decision.BandPolicyVersion != DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1 || !diagnosticDigest.MatchString(decision.ResultDigest) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	result := DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1, StudentID: decision.StudentID, CourseID: decision.CourseID, CourseContentRevision: decision.CourseContentRevision, PolicyVersion: decision.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: decision.AttemptID, PlanID: decision.PlanID, PlanRevision: decision.PlanRevision, Correct: decision.Correct, Total: decision.Total, Percent: decision.Percent, Band: decision.Band, BandPolicyVersion: decision.BandPolicyVersion, PlanDigest: decision.PlanDigest, ResultDigest: decision.ResultDigest, CompletedAt: decision.ResultCompletedAt}
	if ValidateDiagnosticResult(result, plan) != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	actual, err := DiagnosticPlacementDigest(decision)
	if err != nil || actual != decision.DecisionDigest {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func DiagnosticPlacementConsumeHash(studentID, planID string) (string, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(studentID) || !canonicalUUID(planID) {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	return diagnosticJSONDigest(struct {
		Schema    string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
		PlanID    string `json:"plan_id"`
	}{DiagnosticPlacementConsumeSchemaV1, studentID, planID})
}

func placementRoute(band string) (string, bool) {
	switch band {
	case "FOUNDATION":
		return "START_FOUNDATION", true
	case "CORE":
		return "START_CORE", true
	case "ADVANCED":
		return "START_ADVANCED", true
	default:
		return "", false
	}
}

func diagnosticPlacementBand(correct, total int) (string, error) {
	if total < 3 || total > 5 || correct < 0 || correct > total {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	percent := correct * 100 / total
	switch {
	case percent >= 80:
		return "ADVANCED", nil
	case percent >= 50:
		return "CORE", nil
	default:
		return "FOUNDATION", nil
	}
}

func DiagnosticPlacementRoute(band string) (string, error) {
	route, ok := placementRoute(band)
	if !ok {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	return route, nil
}

func diagnosticJSONDigest(v any) (string, error) {
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(s[:]), nil
}

func canonicalUUID(raw string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(raw)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == raw
}

func canonicalUTCMicro(value time.Time) bool {
	return !value.IsZero() && value.Location() == time.UTC && value.Nanosecond()%1000 == 0
}

func mustPositiveInt(raw string) int {
	v, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || v < 1 {
		return 0
	}
	return v
}
func CanonicalDiagnosticAssessments(in []DiagnosticAssessment) []DiagnosticAssessment {
	out := append([]DiagnosticAssessment(nil), in...)
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		if out[i].LessonOrder != out[j].LessonOrder {
			return out[i].LessonOrder < out[j].LessonOrder
		}
		if out[i].TaskOrder != out[j].TaskOrder {
			return out[i].TaskOrder < out[j].TaskOrder
		}
		return out[i].TaskID < out[j].TaskID
	})
	return out
}
